summary.text: Protect your details, check the sender and links, and report suspicious messages.

details.heading: Official CPF contact channels
details.body: Calls from CPF Board will only be made from 6227 1188. SMSes will only be sent from "gov.sg" sender ID. Sender's email address will end with @cpf.gov.sg or @e.cpf.gov.sg. WhatsApp sender is "CPF Board Text Us" with the blue badge and phone number 6031 5753.

details.heading: If you are unsure
details.body: Check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline via 1799.

steps.name: Keep details private
steps.text: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details with anyone.

steps.name: Check the sender
steps.text: Check whether the call, SMS, email or WhatsApp message comes through CPF Board's official channel.

steps.name: Check the link
steps.text: Examine links before opening them. Check that the link's domain ends with “.gov.sg”.

steps.name: Report suspicious messages
steps.text: Report suspicious messages spoofing CPF Board. If unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call 1799.

quotes.text: Here are some tips on how to protect yourself against phishing scams pretending to come from CPF Board:
Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details with anyone.
Check the source of the message.
Stay vigilant and examine the links embedded in the message.
Report any suspicious messages spoofing CPF Board via our CPF official hotline or Write to us.
CPF Board will only contact you through these official channels:
If unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline via 1799.
